absences: eielson: the DAF Eielson NOITA article (eielson.af.mil) returned HTTP 403 to fetch, so the NOITA date and the NRC licensing sequence could not be verified from a primary page. Search summaries describe a 2023 rescission and reaffirmation of the Oklo selection, which the shipped 2025-06-11 date does not mention; no check written. A June 2026 Eielson newsletter (search summary only) puts NEPA start in summer 2026.

anpi-jbsa: the Antares Businesswire release returned HTTP 403. The ANS article (2026-04-23, fetched) confirms the JBSA selection but states neither a signed contract nor NRC contingency; no check written.

anpi-buckley and anpi-malmstrom: the ANS article (fetched) confirms the selections but is trade press dated April 2026, outside the 60-day window for a confirmed verdict; no check written. Shipped binding: true on these ANPI selections and on eielson is not supported by any fetched page saying a contract was executed; the check schema has no binding field, so this is flagged here rather than corrected.
oklo-switch: the ~14 GW order-book figure and the 50 MWe unit size were not verified in any fetched page; the check covers only the non-binding status and the 12 GW through 2044 term.
canada-src: the SRC FAQ does not mention the CA$80M government funding figure; that figure remains unverified from a fetched page (search summaries attribute it to the province).
doe-pilot: 'others in safety review' not verified; no sixth criticality found in searches through 2026-11-17. The DOE criticality page is dated 2026-08-06.
uk-lastenergy: no 2026 milestone found for London Gateway or Llynfi; no check written. Search summaries show the London Gateway MoU and a PDR date that differs between sources (June vs July 2025).

Buyer deals 2026-11-14 to 2026-11-17: no buyer deal found in searches. The Oklo-Centrus HALEU definitive contracts (2026-11-12/13) and the Oklo-US Forged Rings manufacturing reservation (2026-11-06) surfaced; the first is already in skip/news.json, the second is dated before the window and is a manufacturing reservation, not a buyer deal.
Urenco-Blykalla HALEU deal (watcher lead): not found in search results, and the Blykalla SEALER unit size was not found, so no item written.
janus, equinix-radiant, romania-nuscale: not checked, per recently-checked.md.

checks.evidence: Switch's own release, undated in the fetched text, describes the agreement as "a non-binding Master Power Agreement" to "deploy 12 gigawatts of Oklo Aurora powerhouse projects through 2044". It says "individual binding agreements will be finalized as project milestones are reached". Search results found no binding PPA signed in 2026.
